argument: The chapter's nine headings do not partition its 68 cards to a usable granularity, and the outlier is the long run rather than the small one. A single heading carries 21 cards across 192 lines (11-arcane-spells:345-537) with no landmark inside it, 29 percent of the file's length under one signpost, while the sibling spell list's widest heading covers 12 cards. Small sections are not the fault: that sibling carries two one-card sections of its own (12-divine-spells:76, 12:357), so this file's one-card plant section (11:334-344) sits inside house practice even though it spends a heading on a single card. A reader hunting one of those twenty-one cards has one heading to work from. The counts are source-decidable; whether the run reads as an undifferentiated mass on the page is a render question I cannot settle, so the repair - fold the singleton away, or add interior signposts to the long run - is a design call for the council.

evidence.claim: Section coverage is lopsided: the energy heading at 345 governs the cards on lines 347 through 529, while the plant heading at 334 governs exactly one card, at 336.
Card counts per heading in the registered file run 15, 4, 3, 5, 5, 1, 21, 11 and 3, summing to the file's 68 cards; the 21-card run occupies lines 345-537.

The sibling list's widest heading covers 12 cards (12-divine-spells:247-356), and each of its two one-card sections (12:76, 12:357) shows that small sections are house practice rather than the defect.
